# Gold Mizan / ميزان الذهب

> Gold price per gram for 24, 22, 21 and 18 karat in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman, computed in the browser from the live ounce price (gold-api.com) and each central bank's official exchange rate, with calculators for jewellery price with making charges and each country's VAT, resale, zakat and the UAE tourist VAT refund. Published by Radif Partners. Arabic (default) and English.

## Data
- Ounce price: gold-api.com (commercial use permitted), refreshed every 5 minutes in the browser; build snapshot as fallback.
- Exchange rates: SAMA 3.75 SAR/USD, CBUAE 3.6725 AED/USD, CBB 0.376 BHD/USD, CBO USD 2.6008 per OMR; KWD and QAR at today's rate (ExchangeRate-API) with a CBUAE fallback.
- VAT: Saudi Arabia 15% (VAT Law art. 2), UAE 5% (Decree-Law 8/2017 art. 3), Bahrain 10%, Oman 5%; investment metals zero-rated in the UAE (Executive Regulation art. 36) and on first supply only in Saudi Arabia (Implementing Regulations art. 36).
- History: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly gold averages (CC BY 4.0).
